blockingFindings.title: Symlinked cache path can be reset outside plugin-sources
blockingFindings.issue: assertManagedGitCachePath only compares path.resolve(dest) with path.resolve(pluginSourcesDir(root)). If .senti/plugin-sources/<source.id> is a symlink to another Git worktree, fs.existsSync(path.join(dest, ".git")) and all later git commands follow that symlink, so fetch/reset/clean/checkout can operate on a directory outside the managed cache even though the textual path is under plugin-sources.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In syncGitUrlSource/assertManagedGitCachePath, reject or remove a symlink cache entry before running any git command, and verify existing cache directories with lstat/realpath confinement against the real pluginSourcesDir(root). Only run fetch/reset/clean/checkout after the actual directory is confirmed to be inside the managed cache; otherwise reclone into a normal directory at dest.
blockingFindings.rationale: R3 requires destructive reset/clean/delete/reclone to be confined to the current root's .senti/plugin-sources area. Following a symlink lets a config-controlled cache entry perform destructive git operations on an arbitrary external worktree, which is a data integrity bug.
